question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**probes**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate title of the given passage is 'The Historical Work of Tacitus'.
 
• In the fifth blank, the most appropriate word is 'probes'.
 
• It means 'to ask questions in order to find out secret or hidden information'. (रहस्‍य या गुप्‍त बातें मालूम करने के लिए सवाल पूछना)
 
 
• *Example: The newspapers are now **probing** into the President’s past.*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **bargains**: something that is cheaper or at a lower price than usual. (सस्‍ता सौदा, लोगों अथवा समूहों के बीच परस्पर सहयोग का समझौता)
 
• **listens**: to pay attention to somebody/something in order to hear him/her/it. (किसी बात को सुनने के लिए उस पर ध्यान देना)
 
• **imbibes**: to absorb something, especially information. (ग्रहण करना या आत्मसात करना, विशेषकर सूचना; अन्तःशोषण करना)
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *If writers only dared to dare, a Suetonius or a Tacitus of the Novel could exist, for the Novel is essentially the history of manners, turned into a story and a play, as is History itself often enough. And there is no other difference than this: that the one, the Novel, cloaks its manners under the disguise of invented characters, while the other, History, provides names and addresses. Only, the Novel **probes** much deeper than History.*
